about: Every source the missile builds draw on (claude/plans/air-fa18c.md #9): the AIM-9M and the AIM-120C. use: trace = may be traced and matched; facts = its facts may be cited, its figures are never traced into the repository; look = looked at only. fetch.py (../fa18c/fetch.py --catalogue references.json) downloads each entry with a url into references/, which git ignores, and checks its hash. Entries with only a page are live web pages, cited for their text.

references.shows: From high above on the left (port) side: roughly 50-60 deg above the wing plane, roughly abeam to slightly ahead. Near-planform view of the upper surfaces of both wings and both horizontal tails. All four tip corners visible: wingtips with AIM-9X on the rails, the port tail clear of everything, and the starboard tail tip beyond the fins.
references.note: in flight, gear up, surfaces near neutral: for the wing's and the horizontal tails' heights (task #16). Gear up. Both wings: TEF and aileron flush with the wing surface; at most a hairline step at the fold line, and no visible droop. LEFs not visibly drooped. The two horizontal tails look symmetric, with no visible differential. Also catalogued in ../fa18c/references.json: here for the AIM-120Cs it carries (the wings' planform).

references.shows: Items 2 and 5 (rollerons, aft end and nozzle). Training AIM-9 carried by hand, three-quarter view from aft; wings stencilled 'WING ASSEMBLY MARK-1 MOD-2'; sharp at 2100 px. Nozzle exit (255-430, 890-1110); rolleron housings at four wing tips: (210-400, 505-650), (660-930, 770-860), (500-680, 1310-1470) with the wheel edge showing, and (20-140, 1100-1180).

references.shows: Items 2 and 5. AIM-9L (caption; stencil 'BEAR BUSTER 5') on a munitions trailer, three-quarter view from aft and above; film scan, grainy but sharp. Nozzle exit with the 'TIGHTEN WING SCREWS' ring at (650-1000, 1630-1980); rolleron on the left wing seen from above and aft (400-790, 1030-1290); rolleron near edge-on at the right wing tip (1480-1640, 1080-1200); 'DO NOT REMOVE, ADJUST OR OTHERWISE TAMPER WITH HANGERS' label (1210-1450, 1520-1760).

references.shows: Item 5 (aft end and nozzle, end-on). AIM-9L rounds (caption) without wings on a weapons skid, aft ends towards the camera, nearly end-on; 1500x2100 only. Right nozzle exit sharp at (1150-1480, 1350-1700), about 330 px across; left nozzle slightly soft at (195-490, 1260-1600); a small round fitting below each aft end at (335-410, 1595-1660) and (1265-1345, 1720-1790); wing attach rails along the aft bodies.
